text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown brilliantly won the race, 
emerging victorious in the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeated, Kitasan Black burned with 
determination to train and better herself 
once more. Satono Crown also reflected on 
the glory she aimed to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Fired up for a rematch against Duramente 
and Kitasan Black, preparations get 
underway—
